vow.skyabyss.hardy.desc: Enemies on the back have 30% more health
vow.skyabyss.thin.desc: You take 25% more damage on the back
vow.skyabyss.bare.desc: No camp tools (benches, furnaces, torches, chests) on the back
vow.skyabyss.hasty.desc: Stop the heart within 45 minutes of entering. Past that, this vow no longer counts
message.skyabyss.vow.menu_foot: Vow tier %s - materials %s%% (up to %s vows). Best tier so far: %s
message.skyabyss.vow.no_back: That titan's back does not exist in this world yet
message.skyabyss.vow.no_camp: Your vow forbids camp tools here
message.skyabyss.vow.timer_broken: Time ran out. The Hasty Feet vow does not count
message.skyabyss.vow.best: New best vow tier (%s). It is kept in the record book
message.skyabyss.vow.title: Title earned: %s
message.skyabyss.vow.closed.not_repeat: Vows open after the group has stilled that heart once
message.skyabyss.vow.closed.started: Vows are locked once trials are under way (they lift when the heart stops)
message.skyabyss.vow.closed.no_back: That titan's back does not exist in this world yet
message.skyabyss.vow.fail.no_back: That titan's back does not exist in this world yet
message.skyabyss.vow.fail.not_repeat: Vows are for repeat runs only
message.skyabyss.vow.fail.started: Vows cannot change once trials are under way
message.skyabyss.repeat.plaza: The anchor stone waits in the same place. No need to hurry this time
message.skyabyss.repeat.w0: The rim of the rift. Your feet remember its width
message.skyabyss.repeat.w1: The shaft walls look lower than before. They are not
message.skyabyss.repeat.w2: The bridge falls in the same order. Cross it calmly
message.skyabyss.repeat.e0: The sentinels sleep here again. Their sleep grows shallower each time
message.skyabyss.repeat.ce1: The captain's hall. The pike is still heavy
message.skyabyss.repeat.heart: The pulse no longer startles you. Your feet are still a little heavy
message.skyabyss.repeat.tide_landing: The scent of tide is unchanged. Your old footprints are gone under the water
message.skyabyss.repeat.tide_garden: The garden's pearls ride the same tide. Read the current and skip the detour
message.skyabyss.repeat.tide_watch: You remember the cape lights' colors. The order stuck after that one time
message.skyabyss.repeat.tide_flats: The flats become a road again when the tide goes out. Waiting is part of the way
message.skyabyss.repeat.storm_landing: The wind along the tail blows as before. The wingbeats can be counted
message.skyabyss.repeat.storm_west: The west wind hums low again. Match your steps to its breath
message.skyabyss.repeat.storm_east: Your body remembers the east lightning's rhythm
message.skyabyss.repeat.storm_front: The forward vane. The third bolt is nothing to fear now
message.skyabyss.repeat.storm_heart: The thunder hall. Listen for the quiet before the crack
message.skyabyss.repeat.ember_mouth: Heat waits deep in the mouth. The red breathes in the same color
message.skyabyss.repeat.ember_throat: The ash in the throat is cold again. You should remember where to step
message.skyabyss.repeat.ember_west: Your feet know the western ash road. It is short if you stay sharp
message.skyabyss.repeat.ember_east: Read the eastern colors. Even if you think you know them, look again
message.skyabyss.repeat.ember_south: The southern hearth. The fire draws breath in the same spot every time
message.skyabyss.repeat.ember_heart: Heat waits beyond the lattice. You can approach more quietly than before
message.skyabyss.steles.rung_repeat.whal: The stone answers in the note it sang before
message.skyabyss.steles.rung_repeat.tide: The tide stone rings as low as it did before
message.skyabyss.steles.rung_repeat.stor: The wind stone remembers the wind's direction
message.skyabyss.steles.rung_repeat.embe: The ember stone is still warm. Under the ash it remembers the old fire
message.skyabyss.steles.touch_repeat.wha: This stone has sung before. You know the way
message.skyabyss.steles.touch_repeat.tid: This stone has sung before. You already know how to read the tide
message.skyabyss.steles.touch_repeat.sto: This stone has sung before. The wind blows the same way
message.skyabyss.steles.touch_repeat.emb: This stone has sung before. The fire breathes the same breath
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.repeat_not:
You're back.
The same road sounds different the second time.
...If you want to walk it with a few ties on, type "/vow".
skyabyss_record.d.vow_best: The heaviest set of vows you have cleared this heart with (max 6). Titles are cosmetic; gear odds do not change. Swear vows with /vow before boarding or at the first rest spot.
